title: Label: Saint-Émilion Grand Cru
scenario: **Château Lacoste** · Grand Cru Classé · **SAINT-ÉMILION GRAND CRU** · Appellation Saint-Émilion Grand Cru Contrôlée · **2017** · 14% vol · 750 ml · Bottled at the château

questions.explanation: In Bordeaux the château is the producer. Saint-Émilion Grand Cru is the designation; Grand Cru Classé ranks the producer.
Merlot — Saint-Émilion is on the right bank, limestone and clay, with Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvignon added.

questions.stem: Which part of Bordeaux does this wine come from?
questions.explanation: Saint-Émilion and Pomerol are the right bank. The left bank (Médoc) is Cabernet Sauvignon country.

questions.stem: To carry *Saint-Émilion Grand Cru*, the wine needs a higher minimum alcohol and a controlled number of grapes per plant.
questions.explanation: Also a tasting by experts. Plain Saint-Émilion has looser rules.

questions.stem: What is **Grand Cru Classé** on this label?
questions.explanation: Saint-Émilion's own classification ranks producers: Premier grand cru classé and Grand cru classé. The designation is still Saint-Émilion Grand Cru.
